title: Credit Score Holdback on the Neighborhood Access Grant
content:
A credit-score holdback applies to every Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant award. It is read from the representative credit score recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File, and the holdback is subtracted from the starting amount of the grant award, ahead of the lowering to the program's credit cap and the rounding to the cent.

| Representative credit score | Holdback |
|---|---|
| below 640 | 500.00 |
| from 640 through 679 | 250.00 |
| 680 or more | nothing |

### Clause

A representative credit score below 640 holds back 500.00, a representative credit score from 640 through 679 holds back 250.00, and a representative credit score of 680 or more holds back nothing.

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical scores)

| Score | Band | Holdback |
|---|---|---|
| 639 | below 640 | 500.00 |
| 640 | 640 through 679 | 250.00 |
| 679 | 640 through 679 | 250.00 |
| 680 | 680 or more | nothing |

### Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A grant whose starting amount is 4900.00, on a file with a representative credit score of 655, carries a holdback of 250.00; 4900.00 less 250.00 is 4650.00 before any lowering to the cap.
